title: Conditional Test Compilation
summary: Isolate unit tests inside mod tests annotated with `#[cfg(test)]`.
lecture: The `#[cfg(test)]` attribute ensures test code is only compiled when running cargo test.
Grouping tests in an inner mod tests module allows testing private functions in the same file.
Inside the test module, use super::*; imports all items from the outer module.

example.caption: use super::*; grants tests access to private functions.
